import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_88/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_88/training_1.csv"
source2_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_88/training_2.csv"

Source3_88_0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
Source3_88_1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)
Source3_88_2 = pd.read_csv(source2_path, index_col=0)

# Operation History:
# 1) JOIN Source3_88_2 and Source3_88_0 on playlist_id
# 2) JOIN the result with Source3_88_1 on track_id

# Join Source3_88_2 and Source3_88_0 on 'playlist_id'
join_1 = pd.merge(Source3_88_2, Source3_88_0, on="playlist_id", how="inner")

# Join the above result with Source3_88_1 on 'track_id'
join_2 = pd.merge(join_1, Source3_88_1, on="track_id", how="inner")

# Reorder and select columns to match target schema:
# Target schema: ['playlist_id': int, 'track_id': int, 'interaction': int, 'index_playlist': int, 'index_track': int]

Target3_88 = join_2[['playlist_id', 'track_id', 'interaction', 'index_playlist', 'index_track']]

# Ensure correct dtypes as integers
Target3_88 = Target3_88.astype({
    'playlist_id': 'int64',
    'track_id': 'int64',
    'interaction': 'int64',
    'index_playlist': 'int64',
    'index_track': 'int64'
})

# Write the result to the specified path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_88/target_multisource.csv"
Target3_88.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
